(a) scripts/lib.sh:31-37 require_disk now runs `python3 "${BASH_SOURCE[0]%/*}/disk-policy.py" "$@"` and increments FAILED on failure; the old free_gb/awk implementation is gone. (b) scripts/project-node.sh:31 parses --reclaim-disposable; lines 48-52 build disk_args and append --reclaim-disposable only when `[ "$MODE" = apply ] && [ "$RECLAIM" -eq 1 ]`, then `require_disk "${disk_args[@]}" || { say "NODE: FAIL (disk admission)"; exit 1; }` — fail-closed, and `grep -n '|| true'` over project-node.sh/node-create.sh returns no admission swallow (only unrelated lib.sh:13 have() and lib.sh:28 chmod). scripts/disk-policy.py:202-204 emits `FAIL  disk — <free> KiB available (<gib> GiB free); floor <floor> GiB; below floor`, naming the measured numbers. (c) scripts/node-create.sh:54-56 stages the helper fail-closed: `if ! "$b" cp "$HERE/disk-policy.py" ... ; then bad "stage_disk_policy" "copy failed"; exit 1; fi`, and forwards NODE_DISK_FLOOR/--reclaim-disposable at lines 63-66. (d) `python3 -B tests/disk-contract.py` -> exit_code 0, output `Ran 18 tests in 4.646s` / `OK` (includes test_creator_stages_helper_and_stops_on_copy_failure, test_creator_forwards_floor_and_reclaim_before_remote_install, test_low_disk_stops_before_install_clone_and_state, test_reclaim_enables_admission_and_repeat_is_idempotent). (e) tests/selftest.sh adds section `11. disk admission refuses below floor and names the numbers` with a hermetic `df` stub on PATH driven by FIXTURE_FREE_KIB, asserting `FAIL  disk — 1048576 KiB available (1 GiB free); floor 5 GiB; below floor` and the healthy `PASS  disk — 5242880 KiB available (5 GiB free); floor 5 GiB`; `bash tests/selftest.sh` -> exit_code 0, final line `SELFTEST: PASS` (checks 2-4 and 10 also PASS). (f) CF-034/036/037 intact: project-node.sh:64-66 keeps the single `000` reach status, :128-131 keeps the missing-ref message, :134 keeps the deploy-key hint; scripts/harness/install-hermes.sh is untouched (Python 3.14 refusal still present at line 100 area) and selftest checks 2/3/4/10 pass. (g) Scope: `git show --name-only HEAD` = scripts/disk-policy.py, scripts/lib.sh, scripts/node-create.sh, scripts/project-node.sh, tests/selftest.sh; grep for `^(board|\.gitreins|docs/audits)` returns none. Note: scripts/disk-policy.py is a fifth file beyond the four named, but it is the helper the criterion itself requires lib.sh to delegate to and node-create.sh to stage (added by c078906 as a test-only helper, now hardened with a reclaim lock and recovery re-measurement); this is not a board/.gitreins/docs/audits violation and does not revert origin/main behavior.
CF-007 disk admission wiring is fully restored: lib.sh delegates to disk-policy.py, project-node.sh gates --reclaim-disposable to apply mode and fails closed naming measured numbers, node-create.sh stages the helper fail-closed, disk-contract passes 18/18 (exit 0) and selftest prints SELFTEST: PASS with a new hermetic disk boundary fixture, with CF-034/036/037 preserved and no board/.gitreins/docs/audits changes.
